verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the edges of this story. Entra docs describe automatic SCIM provisioning of users and groups into applications, Entitlement Management access packages, and lifecycle workflows that run automatically against users, all of which point toward bulk, rule-driven access rather than one-by-one grants. Nothing in the pack documents dynamic membership rules or assigning an enterprise app to a group. Missing for 10: documented dynamic group membership rules, explicit group-based app assignment, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
